data.desc: Smartbird, Inc. (NASDAQ: BIRD) designs, builds, and operates dedicated AI infrastructure for enterprises. Delivered as a managed service, Smartbird provides the performance, control, and security of dedicated infrastructure without requiring customers to shoulder the capital investment and operational complexity of running it themselves. Each Smartbird cluster is mapped 1:1 to its customer and deployed on-premises or in a dedicated colocation environment, with data center sites under development in the U.S. and Europe. Smartbird is headquartered in Palo Alto. Learn more at smartbird.ai.
